description: Activating a new SIM involves more than simply inserting the card into your phone. Depending on the operator and connection type, you may need to complete KYC, verify your details and wait for the network to become active. The process is different for eSIMs, which require you to request and download an eSIM profile on a compatible device. This guide explains how to activate physical SIM cards and eSIMs in India, troubleshoot common activation issues, and understand what happens to your old SIM.
title: How to Activate a New SIM Card: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Mobile subscribers in India can easily port their existing phone number from one network to another of their choice. The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) says that to avail the Mobile Number Portability (MNP) facility, the activation in the current operator’s network has been more than 90 days, all your outstanding dues towards the TSP need to be cleared, and your phone number should not be sub judice, or its portability has not been prohibited by the court of law. You need to first generate a valid Unique Porting Code (UPC).
title: How to Port Your Mobile Number From One Network to Another: A Step-by-Step Guide

title: Best Smartphones With 200-Megapixel Cameras to Buy in India in 2026: Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Galaxy S26 Ultra, More

description: The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series could mark a major shift in Qualcomm's flagship smartphone strategy. The company is expected to introduce two chipsets, with the Pro version positioned above the standard model. Both are tipped to use a 2nm process and a new Oryon CPU design, while the Pro variant could bring an Adreno 850 GPU and LPDDR6 support. Xiaomi, Samsung and OnePlus are among the brands linked to phones using the upcoming platforms, although specifications and device plans remain unconfirmed.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Series Roundup: Launch Date, Specifications and Expected Phones

description: Apple is gearing up for its annual September hardware event, which is expected to bring a culmination to a year’s worth of rumours. Along with the flagship iPhones, the Apple Watch and AirPods lineups may also be refreshed with new additions.
title: Apple Event Roundup: From the Foldable iPhone Ultra to Watch Series 11, Here's What to Expect

title: Logic LT-IR75CX 75-Inch Review: A Feature-Rich Interactive Display With a Specific Audience
